div.span:
What happens between a player pressing Play in the launcher and the server knowing their progression.
Scope: Arffornia_Launcher_V.5.2@215a845 (msAuthManager.js, minecraftManager.js), msmc 5.0.5, Velocity config in Provisioning@235d0b8, Arffornia_Mods@a72e114 (Arffornia.onPlayerJoin) · derived from code, 2026-10-29
First login shown; with a saved refresh token msmc refreshes instead of opening the Microsoft window. Java, NeoForge and mod sync are collapsed into one note (view content-delivery).
Inferred, not in Arffornia code: the client's session join and Velocity's hasJoined (standard online-mode protocol, onlineMode: true in infra proxy values). The ensure-exists call goes out to the public IP and back through the router to Envoy (G3); the router hop of that hairpin is not drawn.
v0.1 · source: architecture/arffornia/views/player-login.yaml
